items.title: PlayStation Shadowdrops Saros Zenith 更新，包含 Boss Rush、新游戏+ 和精美的金冠 Powerups
items.summary: A new update for Saros dropped today, adding some new features to the hectic Housemarque shooter.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/saros-1792423436499.png

A new update for Saros dropped today, adding some new features to the hectic Housemarque shooter. New Carcosan Modifiers allow players to further tweak the challenge, a boss rush mode lets you compete on leaderboards, and Arjun gets a golden glow.

Zenith adds 10 new Trial Modifiers to increase the challenge level. One example is “Hostile Regeneration,” which allows you to stun larger enemies, but you have to get in and finish them with a melee strike before they recover.

The update also adds New Game+, which adds mysterious new nodes to the Armor Matrix back at Passage. You use these to move through Eclipse Layers, which ramp up the challenge with new rules and deadlier enemies.

During Eclipse Layers, Arjun dons a golden crown and his armor glows. The more trials you have active, the more it glows and the flashier his gilded attire gets. Wearing the crown also grants access to new story and lore entries called Visions.

Then there’s Overlord Rush, accessed via the primary unit in Passage. This is a training simulation boss rush mode that lets you take down the fiercest Saros enemies and compete for a place on global leaderboards.

“Overlord Rush is divided into multiple Sets, each of which contains a different selection of Overlords,” the post on the PS Blog said . “The Incursion and Ascension Sets contain three Overlords each, and can be completed in 10 minutes, for a nice little Saros snack. The final Set is known as Totality. As the name implies, it lines up all eight Overlords from around Carcosa in one continuous gauntlet!”

Elsewhere, Housemarque has added a bunch of accessibility modifiers for people who are struggling with Saros, including the ability to slow projectiles down, giving you more time to dodge. “You have control over how much the game slows down, and can even choose if you want the setting to kick in automatically during combat, or if you want to manually toggle it on when things get hairy,” the blog said.

There’s also a new Auto Fire setting you can toggle on, which fires your weapon for you whenever you’re aiming at an enemy. You can also change the controls to aim with the motion sensor, for players who can’t get used to patting their head while rubbing their tummy and running on a treadmill at the same time.

“We here at Housemarque are super excited for everyone to get their hands on the new content Zenith adds,” Housemarque said. “I can’t wait to hear what players think about all the new control options, see your Crown-equipped Photo mode snaps, and compete (and likely lose) to your high scores in Overlord Rush.”

items.summary: Not Trailing Behind. Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter released last year to near-universal acclaim from critics a

content.v: Not Trailing Behind.

Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter released last year to near-universal acclaim from critics and fans. It was a lovingly crafted, ground-up remake of the first game in the Legend of Heroes franchise, originally released in 2004. The remake brought full 3D visuals, nuanced combat and a range of quality-of-life additions that made it far more approachable for newcomers.

With Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter , Nihon Falcom has followed this crowd-pleasing rebirth with a sequel that’s every bit the success of its predecessor, with the added edge of a stronger narrative and slightly darker tone.
Read the full article on nintendolife.com

items.title: 十款最佳《使命召唤》多人游戏
items.summary: Call of Duty has been the king of FPS multiplayer for years, but what is the king of kings? Black Ops? Modern

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/cod-blog-1792404499538.jpg

With 22 games in its mainline series and a 23rd inbound, Call of Duty is a well-oiled machine, arriving every year like a tactically placed care package to offer multiple modes for every type of player. Modern Warfare 4 refuses to break that trend, with a dedicated campaign, DMZ extraction mode, and the ever-present multiplayer. But how will Modern Warfare 4’s multiplayer stack up against what came before? What king does it need to topple to be declared the best in class? Let’s find out.
These are the 10 best Call of Duty Multiplayer Games.
10. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (2023)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/cod-mw3-2023-1792158049217.jpg

Infinity Ward’s second game in its Modern Warfare reboot series proved divisive. A year later, Sledgehammer Games was given the difficult task of taking the bones of Modern Warfare 2 and reworking it to address fan feedback. It achieved that goal in spades. Unlike the campaign, which was universally disliked, Modern Warfare 3 ’s multiplayer stood tall as the entry’s defining mode.

Modern Warfare 2’s worst additions were removed. The snappy movement of 2019’s Modern Warfare returned, and the recharging perks were scrapped in favour of a gear system that mirrored the classic perk structure. Tac-Stance was introduced, a midpoint between ADS and hipfire that offered better accuracy than the latter but faster movement than the former. And in a series first, all of the previous year's content was carried over into this new release, resulting in a staggering 105 weapons on launch day.

Having great core mechanics would be largely useless without fun maps, though. Rather than start anew, Sledgehammer brought back all 16 original Modern Warfare 2 maps, the 2009 classics given a new coat of glossy paint. It was a lethal combo: modern gameplay design in classic and familiar playgrounds.
9. Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/cod-blops-cw-1792158099556.jpg

Despite suffering a troubled, COVID-impacted development, Black Ops Cold War beat the odds and delivered a multiplayer mode that delighted fans in 2020. Taking us back to the 1980s for the first time in almost a decade, Cold War brought back Black Ops’ original spy-espionage tone and buffed it with all the modern flair and enhancements we saw in Infinity Ward’s Modern Warfare reboot.

The new Gunsmith and create-a-class structure of Modern Warfare 2019 was melded with Treyarch’s signature free-form customisation from Black Ops 2 and 3. Wildcards became a selectable class item, letting you equip three additional weapon attachments or an extra perk without sacrificing any of your class options. These smart adjustments ensured Black Ops Cold War had the core feel of classic Call of Duty, even if that core had been augmented with Modern Warfare’s modern enhancements. Everything worked in tandem, delivering a sleek, respectable package of old and new.
8. Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/cod-blops6-1792158147355.jpg

Treyarch was permitted four years to develop Black Ops 6 , a previously unheard of luxury in Activision’s Call of Duty factory. During that extended production period, it took the leap to set Call of Duty in the glorious 1990s for the first time in the series’ history, unlocking with it a whole host of period-specific weapons and equipment. More importantly, though, the long development cycle also gave the studio room to take big swings with COD’s core gameplay mechanics.

Arguably the best addition Treyarch blessed Black Ops 6 with was a brand new movement system. Omnimovement turned the basics on their head, letting you sprint, slide, and dive in any direction. This significantly increased the pace of combat and heightened the skill ceiling. If you were good at COD, other players could literally see that in the way you moved.

From Omnimovement to the addition of human shields, which let you roast an enemy via voice chat while using them to block incoming bullets, Black Ops 6 certainly got a lot right. With 16 maps, a variety of modes, and a healthy selection of brand-new weaponry, it delivered an experience many fans still remember fondly.
7. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (2011)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/cod-mw3-1792158206173.jpg

After the wild success of Infinity Ward’s original Modern Warfare 2, tackling the next game in Call of Duty’s flagship sub-series was naturally going to be a huge challenge, especially considering a good chunk of the original team had left to make Titanfall. The solution was for three studios – Infinity Ward, Sledgehammer Games, and Raven Software – to combine their efforts. Together, they not only built on MW2's success, but also pushed the series forward with Modern Warfare 3 .

Using the customisable killstreaks introduced in Modern Warfare 2 as a base, the team created the all-new Strike Packages system, which complemented your chosen playstyle with rewards tailored to your chosen class. You could now take a standard approach with the Assault package, be a team player with support (which limited lethal streaks but prevented the streak from ending on death), or go all-in with Specialist, which removed all streak choices in favour of perks, turning you a bonafide supersoldier.

Modern Warfare 3 retained MW 2’s brisk pace, but significantly dialled back the frustrating chaos of One-Man Army Pro explosives spam and Commando melee attacks. The exploitable playstyles were gone, and a renewed focus on your gun through weapon perks combined with the new Strike Packages to bring attention back to the gun-on-gun combat the series is best known for.
6. Call of Duty: Black Ops 3
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/cod-blops3-1792158263958.jpg

While Call of Duty had visited the future before, it had only dipped its toe. With Black Ops 3 , it jumped in with both feet. Set in 2065, Treyarch’s sub-series traded Cold War espionage and “the numbers” for jet-packs and “train go boom”.

While not the first game to rethink player movement, Black Ops 3 introduced a feel that would define this short-lived era of COD, significantly improving the clunky and limited thrust jumps of Advanced Warfare. The new approach gave you greater control when jumping and sliding, but also allowed for wall running. Maps took full advantage of the new movement, letting you string techniques together to get the drop on unsuspecting opponents.

More significantly, Black Ops 3 was, for better or for worse, the first game to introduce Specialists. These were individual hero characters, akin to those found in Overwatch or Marvel Rivals, that could bring a special ability into battle. Typically, you’d choose between a weapon and a special gadget, like active camo.

The combination of advanced movement and Specialists created a Black Ops that felt unique, while also retaining the smooth gunplay the series was known for. It’s generally considered the best entry of the advanced-movement era.
5. Call of Duty: Black Ops
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/16/cod-blops-1792158324432.jpg

Following a very safe retreat back to the 1940s for World at War, Treyarch decided to take a 20-year step forward with Black Ops , giving us our first taste of the era defined by (very explosive) espionage.

The dusty streets of Modern Warfare’s urban battlegrounds and the dark, oppressive theaters of World at War were gone. In their place was everything from the thick jungles of Vietnam to a hidden military facility atop a snow-covered mountain. Multiplayer was defined by a huge leap forward for customisation. Additions ranged from small details like clan tags etched into guns to a plethora of operator skins tied to Tier-1 Perks, face paints, and, of course, the infamous emblem editor.

items.title: 卢卡斯影业超越大工作室，星球大战游戏可能会变得更有趣
items.summary: This year has seen the launch of two Star Wars games, with each one offering a new take on a galaxy far (far!)

content.v: This year has seen the launch of two Star Wars games, with each one offering a new take on a galaxy far (far!) away. Bit Reactors' Star Wars Zero Company puts its best XCOM foot forward with an aggressive take on turn-based tactics, while Fuse Games' Star Wars Galactic Racer has been hailed for its superb roguelite racing, slick presentation, and the delightful Biddy Blas . Both games have been well received by critics and fans alike, and Lucasfilm Games has been paying attention to the success these independent studios have achieved.

"It very much is part of the strategy," Lucasfilm Games VP Douglas Reilly said to The Game Business Show . "Obviously, huge AAA games like Battlefront are always going to be an essential part of the strategy. But one of the great things about Star Wars is it has all kinds of other opportunities to tell stories in different genres. The goal has been to find the best partner to bring that experience to life inside the galaxy far, far away. And it doesn’t have to always be AAA; sometimes it can be AA, and it’s really about the experience that we’re delivering and the fantasy we’re fulfilling."

Reilly added that Lucasfilm Games wants to be more flexible in choosing who it partners with to create more Star Wars titles, and some of those studios will "surprise" people when they're eventually revealed. As Reilly put it, Lucasfilm Games isn't looking for a "top five publisher," but rather teams that can meet their expectations for a high-quality title.

Even if the developer hasn't established a track record yet, having experienced members on staff can help. Fuse Games is a good example: it was founded by former Criterion Games developers who worked on EA's Burnout and Need for Speed series, as well as the two Star Wars: Battlefront games at the publisher.

That's not to say that AAA Star Wars games can't be successful, as the Battlefront series has been hugely popular --controversial lootboxes and all--and as of 2019, they'd sold through 33 million units combined.

Konami has also experienced success in recent years by entrusting the Silent Hill franchise to developers outside of its corporate borders. Between Bloober Team, NeoBards Entertainment, and Screen Burn Interactive, Silent Hill has been on a hot streak over the last couple of years.

As for future Star Wars games , one of the biggest ones in development is the single-player RPG Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic . Like Zero Company and Galactic Racers, it's being produced by a brand-new developer, Arcanaut Studios, under the direction of Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and Mass Effect veteran Casey Hudson.

items.title: 随着《GTA 6》约会系统的推出，令人惊讶的是，有比例的成年人认为投资电子游戏关系是作弊行为
items.summary: With GTA 6's Dating System Incoming, a Surprising Percentage of Adults Think Investing in a Video Game Relatio

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/vintage-vice-city-pack-exclusive-looks-01-1792422938955.jpg

GTA 6 is coming in November and focuses on a relationship between its dual protagonists, Jason and Lucia. The recent GTA 6 launch trailer featured three steamy intimate scenes in the shower, and, according to GTA 6 previews , Jason and Lucia can kiss at the touch of a button and are able to walk around holding hands. Screenshots suggest the pair can go on beach dates and shopping trips, and Rockstar has said that their relationship can blossom or wilt depending on how quickly you text back on the in-game mobile phones.

That Bonnie and Clyde-style relationship is at the center of Rockstar’s upcoming game, and you’ll be able to engage with it as much or as little as you want. But you might want to speak to your romantic partner in real life first.

In September, British polling company YouGov asked 4,000 British adults whether they’d consider dating in a video game as cheating or not. Around 6% of respondents said they would consider it cheating, while a further 19% said that while they didn't consider it cheating, they wouldn’t be okay with it.

That’s a fairly surprising number of people who think smashing pixels together is some kind of betrayal. Women were considerably more against it than men. Only 4% of men would consider it cheating, while 7% of women would. Of those that didn’t consider it cheating but still weren’t okay with it, that was 13% of the men and 24% of the women asked.
The BBC published an article on the poll, leading with a headline that was a question: can you cheat on someone with a video game character? This framing has led to a bit of backlash from players.
“No, video game characters are not real, get a grip ffs!” said Stetson Spatula . “Can you get arrested for murdering someone on call of duty?” asked another X / Twitter user .

A lot of the responses focused on established games such as The Sims, which let you live an alternative domestic life where your Sims marry, have children, and follow career paths while decking out their house. The perceived hypocrisy here is that players have been roleplaying relationships for a long time before GTA 6.

GTA 6's potential for "cheating," has come up before. In August, we reported on how a swath of angry spouses on social media said they thought GTA 6's relationship mechanic was so in depth that it was equivalent to cheating on your real-life partner and worth breaking up over. Over on TikTok, for example, a number of concerned people said they wouldn't let their partner to play the game.

Rockstar has also been very clear that you don't actually have to engage with this part of GTA 6 if you don't want to. Jason and Lucia want a relationship at the start of the game, but it's up to the player to actively pursue that. If you don't, they won't be as head-over-heels for each other, but will still have each other's backs when it matters most. If you do choose to make the two a power couple, you'll likely get more mileage out of the game, though.

"When you bring them together, it feels like you’re a steward of their relationship, and you feel protective of them as a unit," Rockstar North co-studio head, Rob Nelson, told IGN. "But this is something we did not know when we started, and it really had to be something we felt our way through. But I will say that whether you’re getting in trouble, or you’re running from the cops, or getting in a car, or waiting for the other one — playing as them together feels very cool. It feels like you’re taking care of them, if that’s something you’re into."
Rockstar is currently pushing hard on the marketing front ahead of next month’s release. Last week saw real cars modified to look like GTA vehicles being driven around Miami.

items.title: 开放世界犯罪游戏 Samson 在主机上表现更好，但不足以挽救其开发商的关闭
items.summary: Liquid Swords, the Swedish developer behind the crime game Samson , is closing up shop. Founder Christofer Sun

content.v: Liquid Swords, the Swedish developer behind the crime game Samson , is closing up shop. Founder Christofer Sundberg confirmed this after bankruptcy reports emerged, stating directly, "Liquid Swords is closing."

Samson launched on PC in April, but the console edition for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S that released in September "did far better," Sundberg said. However, he admitted that, "It wasn't enough to save the studio."
At the same time, Samson might have a future after Liquid Swords closes up shop, the executive said.
"I’m proud of our team and what we built. We’re discussing continued support for Samson. We make mistakes, we learn, we rise, we move on. I never give up. More soon," he wrote.

According to a report , all 27 employees at Liquid Swords are being let go as part of the bankruptcy process. Workers reported not getting paid for two months, but those salaries will be covered by local laws in Sweden.

Liquid Swords described itself as a "zero-nonsense" game studio. Sundberg said, "Game development has become so full of distractions that affect quality and motivation." He said his ambition was to "change that" with Liquid Swords through eliminating crunch and "useless" meetings, and not taking on an "unnecessary stakeholders."
In the end, this plan did not work out, and Samson will be Liquid Swords' one and only release.

Sundberg co-founded Just Cause studio Avalanche and spent more than a decade there before leaving to start Liquid Swords. Sundberg is known for his hot takes on the gaming industry, including a very bleak outlook on the state of gaming today .

items.title: 《猛鬼追魂》团队把被禁当目标！就是要做大尺度黄暴
items.summary: 《猛鬼追魂：复苏》叙事总监Antony De Fault在接受IGN采访时透露，开发团队曾把“至少在世界某个地方被禁、未分级或限制发行”当作…

content.v: 《猛鬼追魂：复兴》叙事总监Antony De Fault在接受IGN采访时透露，开发团队曾把“至少在世界某个地方被禁、未分级或限制发行”当作一项非官方的成功指标，用来检验他们是否真正还原了克里夫·巴克原作的尺度。不过他也强调，游戏不能只让玩家“看到”禁忌，还要让玩家“做出”禁忌行为，因此加入了极端暴力和大量令人不适的互动场景，同时保留了潜行、探索和资源管理等生存恐怖机制。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192304202890.png

在扩展世界观方面，本作没有停留在重现钉子头、黄油球和喋喋不休者等经典角色，而是深入刻画了围绕修道士形成的组织化宗教“猩红教会”。De Fault解释，玩家无法直接与修道士战斗，单纯逃跑也撑不起一整部游戏，因此需要一个“经常与玩家为敌、又能唤起修道士存在感”的势力，而宗教邪教在《猛鬼追魂》的世界观里几乎是顺理成章的延伸。团队还参考了现实中的邪教组织，来解释为什么有人会被这种极端信仰吸引——对归属感、身份认同和“被接纳”的渴望，正是猩红教会招募成员的心理入口。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192304274366.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192304289084.png
克里夫·巴克本人深度参与了游戏开发，从视觉风格、故事母题到角色性格都提供了指导。De Fault提到，先知布鲁诺这个角色曾在“坎普”程度上反复调整，巴克坚持他必须停留在“可信”的边缘，这让团队意识到，尽管原作带着B级片的荒诞趣味，《猛鬼追魂》对创作者而言始终是一件非常真诚的作品。游戏在处理大尺度场面时也做了取舍，既保住了评级，又让心理暗示比直接呈现更令人不安。

items.title: GameSir Nova Lite 2 评论
items.summary: The best deal in controllers at $30 or less right now.

content.v: The GameSir Nova Lite 2 is our new best budget controller for PC. It's extremely well equipped considering the small asking price. Depart with just $30 / £30 of your hard-earned cash, and you'll receive a wireless controller with Hall effect sticks, mechanical D-pad, trigger stops, and programmable rear buttons.

There's enough here that even GameSir's own exceedingly popular G7 Pro is at risk of cannibalisation. The Nova Lite 2 doesn't look that out of shape by comparison, with only quality of life and more advanced features between them. Such as a handful of micro switches and a bigger battery. The G7 Pro is a better all-round controller, but for less than half the cash, the Nova Lite 2 is tough to ignore.

There are some drawbacks with a controller at this price. The plastic doesn't feel great and it's not overly grippy. The software could be smarter and the shoulder buttons wider, too. But they all seem savvy sacrifices for the savings that the Nova Lite 2 delivers.
Buy if...

✅ You don't use a controller often and you're not looking to spend a lot of money: If you use a mouse and keyboard for most of your gaming, you don't need the next best thing. A dependable, wireless pad like the Nova Lite 2 is plenty sufficient for the odd singleplayer game.
Do not buy if...

❌ You want lots of customisation: You can't change the thumbsticks out on the Nova Lite 2, nor are the trigger stops switching between different types of actuation as with more high-end pads. There's no lighting, only a couple of extra buttons, and the software could be better. But, hey, not everyone is into that sorta thing.

Price
The Nova Lite 2 is less than half the price of the G7 Pro , but it's not at a loss for many of the same or similar features. This budget gamepad really packs a lot in.

First off, it offers wireless connectivity at a low cost. It supports 2.4 GHz for PC, via a USB Type-A dongle, and Bluetooth for Android, iOS and Switch. Using the 2.4 GHz dongle, I measured a range exceeding 20 metres, in line of sight, so I wouldn't worry about range at any sensible distances (though Bluetooth and a wall or two will notably trim that down).
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/9sKhLHASqsy6MGHqS9vbgS-1920-80.jpg

Then there are the Hall effect sticks. These sorts of sticks are becoming pretty ubiquitous among gamepads these days—that or TMR, as found in the G7 Pro 8K —but they lower the chance of pesky stick drift making an appearance later in life. This pair lack the premium feel of more expensive controllers but they're otherwise pretty great.

The triggers are also Hall effect, though most are, and offer two modes: full range of movement or stubby li'l clicks. You might get some use out of the shortened trigger stops in fighting games—a more tactile controller may be better suited—though they do come in handy when using the Nova Lite 2 with a Switch 2. I've been using the Lite 2 on Switch and it's very well suited for a mean Mario Kart machine like myself.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qqo6M3z8rbiqVWGEdw6XgS-1920-80.jpg

The mechanical D-pad is a standout feature. It has a great, lightweight click in each direction. It doesn't take much to actuate but you can be quite deliberate with it. For more casual users, it's great for clicking through menu screens, though it could just as reliably be mashed repeatedly in a fighting game.

The face buttons are standard fare. They're just membrane and aren't anything special. The two rear buttons are also not particularly tactile, being hewn from the same plastic as the housing on the controller. That, too, is just okay. I don't expect much more from a controller at this price tag, but it doesn't feel like it's going to break apart between your hands, either. There's no major flex to any of the plastic housing and only a little creakiness when pressed firmly.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cenhuPib3WDUp6PwPwhUgS-1920-80.jpg

Now, for one thing I don't actually like about this controller, and that's the plastic travel case that comes with it. I get the idea, and hey, if you travel with your controller often, it saves the thumbsticks, but for many people, myself included, it feels a bit like plastic waste I could've done without.
GameSir Nova Lite 2 - Value
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cFU6PeiLqLpnrvtWJvsswR-1920-80.jpg

The Nova Lite 2 is superb value for money at $30 / £30 . It lacks some more advanced features, such as a gyro, but makes more than up for it with practical, real-world benefits, such as a mechanical D-pad and Hall effect thumbsticks.

It's a step up over the existing Nova Lite . That's on its way out as our pick as the best budget controller , to be replaced by the Nova Lite 2. That controller is still an option for a slightly reduced fee of $23 / £18 , but the Nova Lite 2's rear buttons, trigger stops, and mechanical D-pad wholly justify the slight increase in cost for me.

items.title: 一件胸罩就3.6亿！"金小妹"维密首秀 丰乳长腿太诱人
items.summary: 凯莉·詹娜首次登上维密T台，身穿约5000万美元（约合人民币3.6亿元）的梦幻文胸。

content.v: 当地时间10月18日晚，2026维多利亚的秘密时尚秀在洛杉矶索尼影业制片厂举行。真人秀明星、美妆品牌创始人凯莉·詹娜惊喜登台，这是她第一次走上维密的T台。同场走秀的还有阿德里亚娜·利马、吉吉·哈迪德、贝拉·哈迪德等模特。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191650154624.jpg
詹娜当晚穿的是维密的“梦幻文胸”。据《Vogue》报道，这件文胸造价约5000万美元（约合人民币3.6亿元），是维密史上最贵的一件；珠宝商表示，正中央那颗黄钻价值约2200万美元（约合人民币1.58亿元）。这也是该系列自2018年以来首次重返T台。她另外配了一对白色羽毛翅膀和白色短裙。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191650238745.jpg
直播画面里，詹娜的男友提莫西·查拉梅坐在前排，一身黑衣、戴着墨镜，一边笑一边鼓掌。詹娜的母亲克里斯·詹娜就坐在旁边，举着手机拍下女儿登台的画面，同排还有她的男友科里·甘布尔。这段反应画面随后在社交平台上传开。两人自2023年开始低调交往，很少公开谈论感情，今年3月的奥斯卡颁奖礼上，詹娜也曾到场陪同。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191650301996.jpg

items.title: 两整托盘的 RTX 5090 在巴西机场“失踪”——价值 495,000 美元的 unobtanium 显卡现在可能在逃
items.summary: Own up, which one of you was it?

content.v: Good news: I know of the existence of two entire pallets worth of RTX 5090 graphics cards—a rare thing in this day and age, as stock appears to have dwindled to virtually zero . Bad news, they've 'gone missing' from a Brazilian airport.

Brazilian electronics distributor Oderço has published an Instagram post drawing attention to the missing Zotac GPUs, which supposedly arrived at Guarulhos International Airport in São Paulo, but then promptly vanished.

"In our more than 38-year history, we have never encountered a situation like this—and we will not remain silent," says CEO Oderço Matos (via Tom's Hardware , machine translation). "Two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 graphics cards have gone missing at Guarulhos International Airport. The merchandise is worth approximately R$2.5 million (at cost), and to date, we have received no answers."

"We are seeking clarification and want to understand what happened," Matos continues. "How can a shipment of such value disappear from within an international airport without any explanation being provided to us?"

The company has not provided the details of the shipment's arrival date or tracking numbers, but the Oderço Group CEO seems more than a little miffed about the lack of official response towards the missing wares. "We are bringing this matter to the public because we need answers," says Matos. "We expect those responsible for the case to come forward, and we hope that the shipment is located."
A post shared by Oderço (@odercodistribuidora)
A photo posted by

R$2,500,000 equates to roughly $495,000 , which represents the acquisition cost for the company. I have no idea how many graphics cards that would equate to once they were broken down into individual units, but two pallets worth? Lots, I think I can say that for certain.

I'd also hazard a guess that "gone missing" may be a euphemism for "probably stolen," as I think the wayward GPUs are unlikely to turn up down the back of an airport lounge sofa. I suppose they could always have become mixed up with other freight and shipped off to goodness-knows-where, but one way or the other, the company claims they haven't made it to their final destination.

Has anyone checked in on the whereabouts of Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, or Trevor Phillips recently? It seems like their sort of caper. Regardless, the GPUs now appear to be at large—and given retail prices for brand new RTX 5090s are truly jaw-dropping right now, anyone who ends up with a couple of pallets' worth may soon be rolling in cash.

items.title: 《Reshine》确定11月26日发售，Steam Demo现已上线
items.summary: 独立游戏工作室 Quite OK Games 宣布，旗下《Reshine》将于 11 月 26 日登陆 PC、Nintendo Switch 、Xbox Series X|S 以及 PlayStation 5 平台，同时

content.v: 独立游戏工作室 Quite OK Games 宣布，旗下《Reshine》将于 11 月 26 日登陆 PC、Nintendo Switch 、Xbox Series X|S 以及 PlayStation 5 平台，同时 Steam 可试玩Demo现已开放。
https://image.gcores.com/b7f0389353a8d5366939c49e180c9b37-1920-1080.png
此次发售日期公布将伴随全新预告片上线、Steam 可试玩 Demo开放，以及Steam Next Fest 活动开启。玩家现在即可亲自体验《Reshine》的修复玩法。
本作由 Quite OK Games 独立开发并自行发行。该三人团队此前因山地城市建设游戏《肋萨拉：顶峰王国》而受到玩家关注。
此次发售日期公布，标志着这个项目迈入新的阶段。游戏最初只是团队希望打造一款更加缓慢、放松体验的小型实验作品。
Quite OK Games的Michał Kubas表示：
“我们想制作一款自己也会喜欢玩的游戏。《Reshine》最初只是一个关于拆解旧物，并赋予它们第二次生命的小想法。看到玩家们能够与这个理念产生共鸣，真的令人难以置信。现在，我们终于可以公布正式发售日期了。”
《Reshine》Demo 现已上线
玩家无需等待到11月，即可提前体验《Reshine》。游戏试玩Demo现已登陆 Steam，玩家可以在正式发售前体验核心修复玩法。
Demo 将于10月19日 Steam Next Fest 开幕当天上线，《Reshine》也将在活动期间参与展示。对于此前体验过早期测试版本的玩家，本次Demo加入了 三个完全不同的新物品供玩家修复。团队也借助此次Demo进一步优化游戏品质与最终方向。
温馨治愈的修复体验
《Reshine》是一款极简、放松的修复模拟游戏，玩家需要将被遗忘的古董重新恢复原貌。玩家将逐步拆解复古物品，清理多年积累的灰尘、铁锈、污渍以及旧漆，修复每个零件，并小心地重新组装完整物品。游戏中：
没有顾客
没有商店经营
没有技能树
没有时间限制
《Reshine》专注于带来真实的互动体验、视觉变化，以及“让旧物重新焕发生机”的简单满足感。团队刻意保持游戏围绕“修复”这一核心展开，而不是加入额外的经营或成长系统。在正式发售前，游戏还会进行最后的优化，并加入一些视觉细节调整，但核心体验不会改变：找到一件旧物 → 拆解 → 修复 → 享受它重新焕新的过程。
从《肋萨拉》到《Reshine》
《Reshine》是 Quite OK Games 的第二款商业作品，此前团队推出了山地城市建设游戏《肋萨拉：顶峰王国》。相比《肋萨拉》中的大型城市建设、资源管理以及策略玩法，《Reshine》选择了完全不同的发展方向。玩家不再管理一座不断扩张的城市，而是一次专注修复一件物品。最终呈现的是一种更加缓慢、更具沉浸感的体验，让玩家享受看到破旧遗忘之物重新变得美丽的过程。
游戏特色
逐件修复精心制作的复古古董
拆解物品，并小心处理每一个零件
清除灰尘、铁锈、污垢、旧漆以及多年留下的痕迹
使用各种修复工具完成工作
感受物品逐渐恢复原貌的视觉变化
近距离探索修复后的物品细节
享受没有计时器、没有压力的游戏循环
没有商店经营系统
没有顾客管理系统
没有技能树
专注于放松体验的修复玩法

items.title: 《COD现代战争》系列可能还有续作！并未明确完结
items.summary: Infinity Ward叙事总监杰夫·内格斯没有明确确认故事已经结束。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192245216285.png
外媒playground报道，《使命召唤23：现代战争4》片尾字幕后的隐藏任务暗示了某位系列核心人物的命运走向，由此引发玩家讨论：本作是否会是重启故事线的最终章？Infinity Ward叙事总监杰夫·内格斯（Jeff Negus）在接受IGN采访时给出了一个留有余地的回答，没有明确确认故事已经结束。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192242498040.png
内格斯表示，团队的目标是讲一个完整的故事：回应前作埋下的问题、收束已经展开的线索，并让熟悉角色面对新的处境。但他同时坦言，2019年推出重启首作时，团队并没有一个覆盖整个系列的长期规划。他将这一过程比作制作电视剧：如果第一季成功，就可以依托已有的基础继续推进，把故事带向新的方向。他还提到，并非每个游戏系列都能走到第四部，尤其当角色经历了如此多的事件之后，因此第四部对团队而言意义特殊。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192243181606.png
采访中还透露了创作层面的考量。团队在写《现代战争4》时不得不正视《现代战争3》结局的后果——普莱斯上尉做出了一个让他无法回到从前的事，这没有改变他的核心动机，但影响了他达成目标的手段，包括他与瓦莱里娅的结盟。叙事上，本作试图把老角色的故事线与普通士兵视角的战争叙事结合起来，两条线共同围绕“个人底线与战争中的抉择”展开。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192243027782.png
内格斯还强调，本作的剧情并非由原本为第三部准备的材料拼凑而成，战役体量比前作更大，开局任务在很大程度上收束了《现代战争3》的遗留问题。尽管结局基调阴暗、带有完结感，但Infinity Ward尚未确认故事彻底终结，内格斯的回应为后续留下了空间，只是目前没有公布任何具体计划。

评论区有人称“追星女梦中情房”，建议全国推广；也有人提醒全国没几家有。

items.title: 《战地 6》开发者承认在外观奇怪的外观上犯了错误，但对可能的人工智能使用保持沉默
items.summary: Battlefield Studios has released a statement regarding Battlefield 6 after players came together to point out

content.v: Battlefield Studios has released a statement regarding Battlefield 6 after players came together to point out oddities and irregularities with some of the game's newest cosmetics, leading many to openly wonder whether they were the result of generative AI.
The developer’s statement admits mistakes with some of the newly released cosmetics, but it did not say whether genAI played a role.

Battlefield Studios said it's aware of the "conversation, memes, and candid feedback" about some of Battlefield 6's new skins and cosmetic items. In particular, fans pointed out that a McNeil skin says "SECUTY" on the shoulder instead of "SECURITY." Battlefield Studios is planning to release an update to address this with the Season 5, Phase 2 patch in November.

"However, we recognize that letting a known visual error go live without quick acknowledgement creates confusion and erodes trust. We are reviewing how we communicate known visual bugs so you aren’t left wondering whether something was intentional or overlooked," the developer said.
Battlefield Studios went on to say it takes pride in "the craft of our world and our gear," and acknowledged that this item missed the mark and does not reflect the developer's own quality standards.

"Seeing visual oddities slip through is frustrating for everyone. We are currently examining our internal processes and workflows to pinpoint how these issues occurred and to see how we can tighten our quality control process going forward," the developer said.
Battlefield Studios also addressed the Midnight Mirage skin design that gives the character five pistols--you can see this below.
The developer said this was an intentional creative choice to reflect the "over-the-top action movie tropes" where soldiers inexplicably always seem to have another weapon strapped to their gear.

"That said, we understand how this could look unintentional when released alongside other cosmetic anomalies. As we continue to try out new ideas to see what interests the community, you help us continue to evolve our cosmetics in Battlefield. Thank you for your continued feedback and support," the studio said.

When Battlefield 6 launched in 2025, people immediately spotted what they thought were AI-created assets , and Battlefield Studios never denied this. The higher-ups at Battlefield Studios are big believers in AI for game development.

While Battlefield Studios may not have acknowledged using AI for in-game assets in Battlefield 6, Activision freely admits to using the technology to create some of its own assets, including with the upcoming Modern Warfare 4.

Brandon Stirrup, who works on the business strategy team at Microsoft for Xbox, said recently that companies using AI in 2026 in their workflows is standard practice across numerous industries, including gaming. He said gamers express "negative sentiment" about it, so developers don't always freely admit to using the tech. "Everyone else accepts reality," he said.
In other Battlefield 6 news, the game was recently added to Xbox Game Pass , and it's marked down on all platforms to celebrate the recent Season 5 launch.

items.title: 《战神》创始人怒喷《劳菲》典藏版雕像：丑爆了！
items.summary: 《战神》系列创始人David Jaffe近日公开抨击《战神：劳菲》典藏版中附带的雕像

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192158084009.png
《战神》系列创始人David Jaffe近日公开抨击《战神：劳菲》典藏版中附带的雕像，直言其品质配不上150欧元的售价，并借此批评PlayStation当前领导层缺乏创意监管，导致品牌标准全面下滑。
Jaffe在视频中指出，典藏版中那座本应是核心卖点的雕像，做工粗糙到令人失望，形容它看起来像“从Temu bargain bin货架上扯下来的廉价塑料玩具”。他并非唯一持此看法的人，雕像公布后不久，玩家社区就对其面部建模的异常提出了大量批评。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192159258619.png
让Jaffe尤为愤怒的是价格与价值的严重脱节。这套典藏版定价150欧元，内含一座八英寸雕像、一副51张的Oracle卡牌和一本迷你艺术画册，但不包含游戏本体。Jaffe指出，市面上带灯光效果的同类雕像，起步价不过20欧元左右，索尼却向忠实粉丝开出了150欧元的价格，他认为这是一个“灾难性的信号”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192159254748.png

Jaffe将矛头直指PlayStation内部文化的变质。他回忆道，在自己任职索尼的年代，开发者、制作人和创意人员会在内部竭力阻止任何不达标的产品流向市场。“在Santa Monica、Naughty Dog、Foster City，走廊里到处都是战士，我们会为了品质和上级抗争。”他举例说，当年一批Sweet Tooth面具因质量不达标，他和市场团队直接叫停了整个分发，终止了与制造商的合作，那批面具最终没有到达任何一位粉丝手中。
而在Jaffe看来，如今那道内部防线已经消失了。“那些战士要么被噤声，要么被耗尽，要么已经离开了这栋大楼。”他批评道，“这是完全缺乏创意监管，没有人站出来说‘不，这还不够好’。我很伤心，因为我怀念那家曾经代表卓越的公司的灵魂。”

items.title: 90岁老人听不清收款语音 购物只付几毛 一月遭坑26次
items.summary: 浙江慈溪一名男子利用老人听不清收款提示音，一个月26次扫码少付款，已被警方抓获。

content.v: 浙江慈溪警方破获一起针对高龄店主的案件。一名男子盯上90岁、听力不佳的小卖部店主，买几十元的商品却只扫码支付几毛钱，一个月内连续作案26起，涉案金额900余元，目前已被抓获。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192157476752.png
这位老人独自经营小卖部，年纪大了之后听力严重衰退，听不清收款音箱播报的具体金额，只能靠听到“到账”提示音，就默认顾客已经付钱。老人本身也不太会操作智能手机，无法实时核对收款流水，账单只能等子女抽空回家整理。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192158286938.png
嫌疑人罗某交代，一个月前他扫码付款时少按了一个0，老人听到提示音就放他离开，尝到甜头之后便开始频繁光顾。他每次选购十几元到几十元的零食和日用品，付款时刻意把金额改成0.75元、0.25元这类数目，音箱一响，老人便不再追问。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192155045114.jpg
直到家属回来对账，发现账单里有大量极低金额的收款记录，而且都来自同一个付款账号，察觉不对后立即报警。警方根据付款记录和周边监控，3小时就锁定并抓获了罗某。到案后罗某对自己的行为供认不讳，目前已被依法采取刑事强制措施，案件还在进一步办理。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192155492812.jpg

items.title: 《神秘海域》三部曲遭搬PC！支持120帧DLSS帧生成
items.summary: 玩家自制非官方移植让《神秘海域》前三作可在PC运行，支持120帧、DLSS与帧生成。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192146429326.jpg
《神秘海域》前三作靠玩家自制的非官方移植， 如今已经可以在PC上玩到， 作者SuperMedo此前也曾做出《血源》的非官方PC移植。虽然索尼在2022年将《神秘海域4：盗贼末路》《神秘海域：失落遗产》 带到PC上 ，但前三部作品依然缺席。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192141102189.jpg
移植对象是《神秘海域：德雷克合集》，包含《神秘海域：德雷克船长的宝藏》《神秘海域2：纵横四海》和《神秘海域3：德雷克的诡计》。技术上不算传统的原生版：游戏原本的x86-64指令直接在PC处理器上运行，GPU部分则通过基于shadPS4的渲染器，把图形指令转译成Vulkan来模拟。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192146539278.jpg
三款游戏都提供60帧和120帧模式，更高帧率还未开发。画面上支持DLAA、FSR 3.1/4以及DLSS与FSR帧生成，RTX50系还能用上多帧生成，键鼠和手柄都支持按键自定义。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192142384476.jpg
据Stargames Benchmarks的测试，在Ryzen 5 7500F与RTX 4070 SUPER组合下，三作能以原生1440p跑到约120帧。也有玩家在RTX 4060上通关了《神秘海域：德雷克船长的宝藏》，1080p加DLAA下多数时候100至120帧，大场景降到80帧左右。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192147065401.jpg
移植仍有部分问题：有玩家遇到偶发崩溃，其中一人在第11章出现存档损坏。最新的0.3.6版本已修复部分画面错误，以及《神秘海域2：纵横四海》火车段落的崩溃。想尝试的玩家需要自备已解密的PS4版游戏文件，项目不提供受版权保护的内容。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792417237_456889_jpg_r.jpg
这部续集在前作上映后便已进入规划，当时计划由杰克逊接替史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格执导，但此后多年没有明显进展。杰克逊此次明确将其列为下一部导演作品，为项目带来了新的推进信号，不过目前尚无开机、选角、发行安排或上映档期信息。

小凡男友表示，追了女友有半年。自己觉得她特别坚强，精神上也比较独立和自由，拥有很多人不具备的品质。女友的身体状况并不是问题，有做不到的事自己可以帮她做，她不上班也无所谓，自己一个月工资一万块钱，可以养活她。一开始父母不同意，自己表示非小凡不娶，一周后他们也同意了。求婚成功后也很激动，想要保护她一辈子。

items.summary: 麦斯·米科尔森谈加盟《使命召唤23：现代战争4》，称儿子是系列粉丝，自己也会成为玩家。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192130216062.jpg
麦斯·米科尔森近日谈到了自己参演《使命召唤23：现代战争4》的经过，他在游戏中饰演一名反派角色。他表示，这份邀约来得很突然，但他从头到尾没有犹豫过。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192131236256.jpg
他给出的理由之一来自自己的儿子：“我儿子大概会因为我的拒绝而杀了我。后来我们和开发团队聊了一会儿。我自己不是玩家，但我会成为玩家的，我保证。”他还补充说，整个沟通过程很顺利，自己对加入这个项目没有任何疑虑。米科尔森也提到，在看过项目提案和几段宣传素材之后，他很乐意成为这款游戏的一部分。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192130118302.jpg

米科尔森此前也有过游戏作品的演出经历，在小岛秀夫的《死亡搁浅》中饰演克里夫·昂格尔。

content.v: 演员马克·沃尔伯格对制作个人数字版本持开放态度，也能接受这一版本在他去世后继续出现在电影或电视剧中。他希望届时由子女和孙辈掌控其面部形象与数字身份，并决定是否授权其参与新的影视项目。

沃尔伯格在TechCrunch Disrupt活动上谈及人工智能对电影行业未来的影响。当被问到是否考虑在CAA Vault建立个人数字资料时，他表示尚未参观该设施，但对这种做法感兴趣。

items.title: 《使命召唤：现代战争 4》真的是重启后的现代战争故事的终结吗？无限病房回应
items.summary: Is Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 really the end of the rebooted Modern Warfare story? We asked Infinity Ward.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/maxresdefault-22-1792416144161.jpg

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s campaign is available now in early access, and is arguably the strongest the series has been since its 2019 revival . Those who have played it will be aware that a lot of its heroes and villains meet their end in one of the darkest COD entries to date. It makes it all feel like a bow being tied on this particular storyline. Activision has confirmed a new Call of Duty subfranchise outside of the traditional Modern Warfare and Black Ops rotation is in the works, further signalling that it may be the end of this particular road.

But is that Activision’s plan, or if MW4 turns out to be a smash success, will the developer be tempted to head back to Captain Price and gang well one more time? The final mission of the campaign, taking place during the middle of the game’s credits, appears to suggest it might be the end of the line for the saga and one of its most beloved characters . It begs the question: Is this the end of the rebooted Modern Warfare story?
“It's a good question, and you'll not love the answer,” Jeff Negus, narrative director at Infinity Ward, told IGN.

“I don't know. What I do know is we tried to tell a definitive, conclusive story in that we were trying to set up, or rather pay off the setups, answer things that had been posed as questions, push characters into new territory that they've never been in before, raise the stakes, push the conflict.”

This new era of Modern Warfare started strongly with 2019’s acclaimed campaign that echoed much of what players enjoyed about the 2007 original. Despite the callbacks, the most exciting thing was that it felt like something fresh, with new characters blending in with familiar faces to tell a new story. The recently released MW4 pulls off a similar trick, weaving in a huge-scale Korean conflict with the more personal Price missions. But the path here was rocky, and not necessarily one that was meant to end here. In fact, it turns out there wasn’t really a fleshed-out idea of where the saga would go post-2019.

“No, there wasn't a long-term plan”, Negus revealed. “Similar to a television show where you got a first season, it comes out, people like it, cool, there's going to be another one. If you do it well, what you built can be built upon in a way where you can use it as a foundation and then push on top of that to build and go to new places.

“Four, that was of particular importance for us. Not many games get a four, let alone one that has these kinds of characters that have gone through the things they've gone through. And so while there wasn't a long-term plan necessarily for the story specifically from 2019, we definitely are self-reflexive in a way where we're looking back at the same time as being in the present in order to inform it and make it more impactful.”

Having the plot of a four-game series being developed over the course of much of the decade not entirely mapped out is understandable, but what may be surprising is that the team didn’t know where this story would be heading just three years ago after the release of Modern Warfare 3.

“It's interesting because at the end of Modern Warfare 3, there were some definitive events that took place,” Negus explained. “And because of that, particularly for Price, once you take that action, you can't come back from it. And although it doesn't change his core motivations, and in that I don't think it changes his character, it does adjust how he tries to achieve his goals; the means changed. And we weren't beholden to it, but we wanted to use it as a way to continue the story in a meaningful way, not go, ‘Don't worry about that thing that happened,’ but really lean into it and say, ‘Well, if he had done that, it would mean this. And if it meant this, how can we use that to push into new territory?’ And that's where an alliance between Price and Valeria comes in.”

There’s a lot going on in Modern Warfare 4’s story, and it's a credit to Negus and the team that it remains coherent throughout, despite having to juggle an extensive cast dotted around much of the globe. It’s a stark contrast to MW3’s limited, plot-light campaign, which introduced fan-favourite villain Makarov in what felt like a rushed manner.

The development time granted to Infinity Ward to construct it was truncated, especially when compared to the three years it had with MW4, and it shows in its quality, but also in its quantity. This is a beefy campaign with a lot of story to tell. So much so that its opening missions almost feel like an epilogue to Modern Warfare 3, as it clears the table ahead of telling its new story. So, in an ideal world, was part of this story ever meant to be in that game from three years ago?

“Short answer, no,” Negus stated. “I think the reason that this story has so much in it is that we had the ambition to continue the legacy character storylines and a very strong impulse to return to form in that, assuming the role of a low-level soldier within a bigger war landscape. And so obviously those characters that we've been with don't really fit that desire in terms of having that perspective. So it was a challenge, but ultimately an opportunity to get to redefine our returning characters and define, for the first time, a whole set of new, young, fresh faces that would give us a totally different perspective. And we combined them together, uniting them by a common theme continuing from 2019, setting up the ‘you draw the line wherever you need it’ that permeates both threads of the storyline and both perspectives.”

This approach is definitely proving a success, with Modern Warfare 4’s campaign receiving widespread praise from fans, and a thank you from the actor behind Captain Price in return to those enjoying it. Have you played it? Did you enjoy it? Let us know in the comments!

We’ve got an in-progress Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Walkthrough to help you through the campaign missions, and a guide to All Yellow Supply Crate Locations for the 10th mission, Stranded. Make sure you don’t miss out on a thing with our guide to All Collectible Note Locations , and all the Code Solutions you’ll need to open every keypad and container.

items.summary: YouTube star Mr. Beast, who has more than 500 million subscribers on that platform alone, has published a Call

content.v: YouTube star Mr. Beast, who has more than 500 million subscribers on that platform alone, is publishing a Call of Duty video today, October 19, to mark the release of Modern Warfare 4. He teased the video online, saying it's going to be "one of the biggest COD videos of all time."
He also pointed out how he started his YouTube career by posting Call of Duty videos, so it's a full-circle moment for him.

The video appears to be focused around MW4's updated DMZ mode, as a title screen in the video references something called "Escape from DMZ." A safe bet would be that Mr. Beast is conducting a competition where participants have to ... escape from DMZ, but in real life.
Other creators who took part have begun to post their own teasers. Check back later today when the video arrives.

Modern Warfare 4 releases on October 23, but if you preorder the game, you can play the campaign right now or the DMZ mode on October 20. The timing of the Mr. Beast video, coming one day before early access begins, is likely not random.

DMZ looks to be updated and improved in some big ways for MW4 , featuring deeper progression and more ways to play. Multiplayer looks solid, too , and the campaign is receiving high marks as it wraps up the current storyline.

content.v: 10月19日，演员李小冉亲自发文，确认与制片人徐佳宁已于去年离婚，直接回应了前夫近日被强制执行2111万余元的风波，声明双方“互不牵扯”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192126023846.jpg
李小冉与制片人徐佳宁相识多年，于2014年6月在长春登记结婚，2015年8月在比利时布鲁塞尔举行婚礼。根据其声明，两人已于2025年离婚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_zy_red_164_18/1142.jpg
2026年7月，网络爆料称两人已于2025年11月办完离婚手续，当时李小冉工作室曾发声明否认。而2025年6月，李小冉退出徐佳宁关联公司全部股份并卸任董事，已先行完成商业切割。10月14日，徐佳宁及其任职的霍尔果斯视外谊海传媒有限公司被法院列为被执行人，执行标的超2111万元。徐佳宁在该公司担任法定代表人、董事及财务负责人。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_zy_red_164_18/1309.jpg
多位律师分析指出，该笔债务为大额经营性债务，目前无证据显示李小冉曾参与相关经营或提供签字追认，因此不属于夫妻共同债务。债权人若主张权利，需另行起诉。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792416134_677713_jpg_r.jpg
YOLO模式无法在初次进入游戏时选择，玩家需要先以任意难度完成战役才能解锁。模式采用写实伤害规则，除了熟悉关卡和敌人位置，玩家还要控制射击角度、武器选择与推进节奏。
战役中的全面入侵场景枪火密集，还有平民四处躲避，风险并不只来自敌人。友军误伤会与普通死亡受到相同惩罚并触发重置，手榴弹等范围武器也可能波及友军或平民，因此很难安全使用。
这名玩家将自己通过相关段落称为“纯粹的运气”。目前可以确认的是其自述的通关结果及YOLO模式规则，尚无完整路线、总耗时、失败次数或全程录像细节，无法据此判断此次挑战是否创造纪录。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: 《 巫师3：狂猎 》重制版Switch 2版补丁上线，本次更新优化了Switch 2游戏的图像锐化和分辨率，以提升画面清晰度和视觉保真度。同时还修复了《巫师3：狂猎》在游戏中不同地区切换时偶尔发生崩溃的问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792415383_640580_jpg_r.jpg
官方公告
《巫师 3：狂猎 — 重制版》Nintendo Switch 2 版本 5.01 补丁现已开放下载，其中包含多项全局及平台专属改进，解决了在大家帮助下确定的问题。
请查看下方改动列表，详细了解 5.01 补丁包含的内容。
游戏玩法
- 修复了“自动涂抹剑油”功能仅在当前游戏会话中启用后才会生效的问题。
- 修复了在特定情况下，玩家操控的船只可能会失控移动并无视地形碰撞的问题。
- 改进了与梯子互动时的动画。
- 修复了使用阿尔德法印终结敌人后，杰洛特会与死亡的敌人发生碰撞的问题。
- 修复了多次施放昆恩法印后，维瑟米尔会反复说同一句台词的问题。
- 修复了闪避操作可能出现非预期响应延迟的问题。
- 修复了即使相关选项已禁用，仍然可以投掷炸弹的问题。
- 修复了“协同作用”技能提供的加成数值显示错误的问题。
- 为“爆裂之盾”技能添加了伤害反射效果。
- 修复了同时冲刺和闪躲时，杰洛特的活力会被完全耗尽的问题。
用户界面
- 修复了“你获得了一个技能点！”弹窗可能一直停留在屏幕上的问题。
- 修复了冥想界面中的操作提示会短暂闪烁的问题。
- 修复了进入消耗品标签页后不会出现魔药教程的问题。
- 修复了用户界面中部分进度条未正确对齐的问题。
- 进行了多项视觉调整，包括对漫反射、色调映射、角色光照、光线追踪和路径追踪的改进。
- 在图形设置中添加了漫反射、光束和景深选项。
- 进行了多项优化以提升性能。
- 修复了动态分辨率缩放在某些配置下可能导致视觉伪影的问题。
音频
- 修复了在暂停菜单各标签页之间切换后，语音音量可能明显低于其他游戏内音频的问题。
Nintendo Switch 2 专属
- 调整了图像锐化和分辨率，以提升画面清晰度和视觉保真度。
- 修复了在游戏内不同区域之间切换时可能偶尔发生崩溃的问题。
- 优化了跨平台模组支持的缓存处理。
- 修复了攀爬梯子时只能在左侧 Joy-Con 2 上感受到 HD Rumble 的问题。
- 修复了可以在地图周围的黑边上放置地图标记的问题。
其他
- 由于后端问题，政策同意界面将再次出现。你需要再次确认自己的偏好设置。选择加入有助于我们改进游戏。
- 修复了如果此前已经打开过维吉玛的宝箱，“我的奖励”和 Twitch/Bilibili Drops 不会出现在宝箱中的问题。受此修复影响，部分物品可能会重复出现。就把它们当作额外奖励吧！
- 修复了植被不会对碰撞产生反应的问题。
- 修复了一个可能影响存档数据的问题，并添加了相应措施，以处理可能已经受到影响的存档。
- 乌克兰语文本本地化现已在所有地区提供。

items.title: 演员王凯回应消失的两年 停工的两年是变化最快的
items.summary: 王凯做客《陈鲁豫·慢谈》，首次正面回应“消失”的两年，直言行业热钱退潮好戏锐减，自己不愿将就演重复角色，主动选择停下来沉淀。

content.v: 据南宁晚报报道，王凯做客《陈鲁豫·慢谈》，首次正面回应“消失”的两年，直言行业热钱退潮好戏锐减，自己不愿将就演重复角色，主动选择停下来沉淀。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_zy_red_164_17/172.jpg
王凯指出，过去热钱涌入影视行业，一年能拍两三部戏；现在资金大量涌入短剧，长剧项目锐减，好戏更少。他强调不是因为没戏找，而是缺乏好剧本、好角色和好制作班底，与其拍重复的东西不如休息。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_zy_red_164_17/1166.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_zy_red_164_17/1168.jpg
他停工的两年正好是行业变化最快的时期，短剧、中剧冲击传统长剧市场，导致大家觉得间隔特别久。王凯认为把时间花在休息上，比花在毫无意义的工作上更有用，自己现在没有必要为了钱拍戏。他希望现实中的自己被观众适当淡忘，把新鲜感留给下一个角色，让观众记住角色而非他本人。
他依然坚持看剧本，没有心动的项目就回归生活，等待能带来不一样东西的作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_zy_red_164_17/1341.jpg

items.title: 《怪猎：荒野》DLC凌越体量超大！"其他作品几倍"

content.v: 在 2026 年 TGS 卡普空展区，预计于 2027 年推出的《怪物猎人：荒野》（以下简称《荒野》）大型扩展内容《怪物猎人：荒野 凌越》（以下简称《凌越》）首次在全球提供试玩。同一展区内，Nintendo Switch 2 版《荒野》也开放了试玩。
本次《Fami 通》编辑部将为大家带来《凌越》制作人辻本良三、总监平冈拓朗、执行总监兼美术总监藤冈要，以及 Nintendo Switch 2 版《荒野》制作人砂野元气的访谈内容。
辻本良三，《怪物猎人：荒野 凌越》制作人。文中简称“辻本”。
平冈拓朗，《怪物猎人：荒野 凌越》总监。文中简称“平冈”。
藤冈要，《怪物猎人：荒野 凌越》执行总监兼美术总监。文中简称“藤冈”。
砂野元气，Nintendo Switch 2版《怪物猎人：荒野》制作人。文中简称“砂野”。
为让猎人能够主动创造机会，“增幅护腕”应运而生
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278895.jpg
—— 《凌越》作为《荒野》的大型扩展内容推出，“增幅护腕”给人的感觉是相当大胆的新增要素。它并不只是对既有内容的补充，而是几乎称得上拥有一款全新作品级别的内容量。请问加入这一增幅系统的契机和理由是什么？
平冈：我们当初其实并没有特别意识到这个新要素的“规模”有多大。决定加入增幅护腕的契机，是回归思考《怪物猎人》动作系统的根本。
在《怪物猎人》中，最基本的动作体验就是猎人抓住怪物的破绽发动攻击。那么，所谓的机会具体是什么？我认为它的基础包括使用陷阱或闪光弹。在《怪物猎人：世界》之后，则还包括利用环境。或者是在怪物疲惫、露出空档的瞬间进行进攻等等。
在《凌越》中，我们原本也有以《荒野》为基础进行制作的想法。但与此同时，我们也开始思考：“是否能加入一种让玩家自己通过行动来创造机会的手段？”如果能做到这一点，或许就能为《怪物猎人》的动作体验增添新的亮点，这就是企划的起点。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278897.jpg
继续深入推敲后，我们形成了这样的机制：当增幅槽蓄满时，玩家会产生“现在或许可以使出这一招”、“也许能由自己来创造机会”的选择。并不是一开始就打算加入一个规模很大的系统，而是在不断尝试“这样做会不会有趣”的过程中，最终形成了增幅护腕这一形态。
—— 在《荒野》最终版本的环境中，不同武器的机动性优劣，似乎会让战斗操作难度产生相当大的差异。增幅护腕是否也有意改善这方面的问题？
平冈：相比之下，增幅护腕的概念更侧重于进一步增幅各个武器种的特色，以及它们“强势的瞬间”。并不是为了弥补机动性较慢武器的短板，刻意把它们变快。
不过，关于只有在增幅发动期间才能使用的特殊动作 —— “增幅发动动作”，我们确实讨论过或许可以稍微放宽一些原有的限制。
比如大剑，平时移动较慢，整体感觉也比较沉重。但在增幅发动动作中，它可以一口气拉近与怪物之间的距离。如果平时就能这样做，可能会违背这种武器的设计理念。但仅限于这一瞬间，或许可以允许它突破原本的限制。我们确实有过这样的考虑。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278898.jpg
—— 除了增幅护腕外，各武器种也新增了动作。请问这些动作是如何讨论并加入的？
平冈：毕竟游戏中有 14 种武器，并不是所有内容都由我一个人决定。每种武器都有对应的负责人，我们会与负责人充分沟通，并结合《荒野》当前的状态，去思考“有没有能够改善的地方”、“有没有加入后会很有趣的要素”。
例如，单手剑新增了名为“刃药斩”的动作。“刃药”本身是从《怪物猎人X》开始登场的元素。我们从这些过去作品的内容中汲取灵感，思考是否能够进一步发挥单手剑攻击次数多、运用灵活的特点。
—— 请为我们介绍一下特别希望玩家关注的武器种或亮点。
平冈：经常被提到的是大锤的“飞身重击（飛び込みスマッシュ）”。我觉得我们大概成功做出了大锤负责人与玩家所期待的东西。最重要的是，它用起来很爽，视觉表现也很出彩，所以我自己非常喜欢。
我个人并不是主玩大锤的玩家，但实际体验之后，会让人忍不住想继续使用它。我认为它已经完成到了这样的程度。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278899.jpg
—— 随着这次新增动作，以往没有具备“相杀”效果动作的武器，也新增了许多相杀动作。对于《凌越》的动作开发来说，“相杀”是否是一个主题？
平冈：再回到增幅护腕的话题。我们希望在玩家推进任务、增幅槽蓄满时，能够创造一个让玩家思考发生变化的瞬间。
我们希望带来一种选择空间：“现在槽已经满了，也许可以采取这个行动。”同时，我们也认为，既然发动增幅时会消耗量表，那么那一刻就应该成为猎人能够强行打出进攻的时机。
在这样的思考过程中，我们很自然地得出了“这里是不是应该有相杀”的结论。结果就是，几乎所有武器种都加入了带有相杀效果的动作。
并不是说我们一开始就刻意想要加入相杀动作；而是我们不断累积那些想作为增幅动作实现的内容后，最终发现其中具有相杀效果的动作变得很多。若大家能这样理解，我会很高兴。
—— 在这次试玩中也能挑战的新怪物“喷冲鸟”，我感觉它的行动模式明显更容易让玩家瞄准相杀。怪物方面最终也是这样设计出来的吗？
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278901.jpg
平冈：就喷冲鸟而言，它在难度定位上并不算特别高。考虑到它会通过翅膀压缩空气并喷射出来的机制，以及它在怪物生态中的定位，我们将它设计成一只攻击前摇比较容易辨识的怪物。
攻击预兆容易看懂的怪物，结果往往也会变得更容易触发相杀，所以大家可能会因此产生这样的感受。
—— 我们在试玩中体验了讨伐喷冲鸟的任务。它是一种群居怪物，首领个体还会做出仿佛向其他个体下达指令的动作，让人觉得非常有意思。请再为我们介绍一下喷冲鸟的设计概念与生态吧。
平冈：喷冲鸟是在名为“云居遗迹群”的新地图中集体行动的怪物。《荒野》中登场的辟兽同样也是会组成群体的怪物，不过辟兽的个体性格比较强烈，每一只都有种“我就是我”的感觉，彼此之间带有一些参差不齐的个性。
而喷冲鸟则与之相反。我们从“如果将它设定为一种能形成纪律严明群体的怪物，会不会很有趣”这一想法出发进行设计。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278894.jpg
当喷冲鸟的首领个体通过鸣叫发出命令后，听到命令的下属 —— 也就是普通个体会靠近它，并与其一同行动。我们最初想做的，就是这样一种“拥有社会性群体的怪物”。
藤冈：我们先确定了要将它设计成一只会冲撞的怪物，接着便与设计师一起思考：该如何让它进行冲撞？最后采用了喷射机制，因为让翅膀如同喷气机一般喷出空气，无论从视觉上还是概念上都很直观，也很有趣。
不过，虽然确定了它会通过喷射来冲撞，具体应该采用怎样的外形，我们还是让设计师进行了相当多的尝试与调整。最后定下的设计，是它会将头部与拳部紧紧收拢、变得非常坚硬，然后向前冲撞。
它的行动本身很简单，但通过向下属发出指令，可以产生变化，也能让多种大型攻击叠加出现。我们希望借由在简单的基本结构中加入复合要素，做出能够带来游戏性的设计。
—— 它从翅膀喷射某种东西的部分，会让人联想到天彗龙，但整体给人的印象却完全不同。
藤冈：我们的设定是，它会像气球一样膨胀起来，再进行喷射。冲撞之前，它的翅膀会充分张开，随后通过压缩空气发动冲撞。无论作为一种视觉符号，还是在实际表现上，这种方式都很容易让玩家理解，因此我们采用了这样的设计。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278903.jpg
《凌越》将在发售时便提供终局内容
—— 从试玩版的 UI 和选项来看，感觉《荒野》玩家曾提出希望加入的功能，几乎全都已经被纳入了。这里是否是基于玩家反馈进行了重点调整？
平冈：在启动《凌越》项目时，我们最先提出的概念就是“让《荒野》获得正统进化”。不过，“正统进化”这个说法的范围太广，所以我们进一步整理了具体该做些什么。
对于玩家喜爱、享受的部分，我们要切实地加以扩展。反过来，对于“如果能这样改进就更好”的部分，以及能够依据反馈进行改善的内容，则要彻底改善。我们认为，这才是《荒野》的正统进化。
UI 和选项设定的改进，也是这一思路的一部分。我们并非会回应所有意见，但会去思考：“既然有这样的意见，玩家是不是希望我们做出这样的调整？”只要是能够实现的内容，我们就会尽量积极去做。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278904.jpg
这是一个玩家热情非常高的作品，因此我们也希望能够认真回应这份热情，并与团队成员一同推进开发工作。
在《荒野》的免费标题更新中，我们也已经进行了各种改进。但涉及根本系统的调整，则必须投入足够的时间，沉下心来认真处理。因此，我们决定将这类工作放到《凌越》中承接。这次有些部分会发生显著变化，也是这一成果的体现。
—— 在卡普空开发者访谈中，经常能听到“重视扩展玩家的游玩方式和选择空间”这样的说法。这是否已经成为卡普空整体范围内的开发方针？
辻本：我们对于自身坚持的内容、希望玩家体验的玩法，以及希望玩家获得的体验，都应该明确地保有想法，而我们确实也有。
在此基础上，如果玩家在接触这些内容时感到不够顺畅。或者某些我们有意加入的设计不容易被玩家察觉，又或者我们希望玩家尝试某种玩法，但对应功能没有充分发挥作用，那么这些部分就需要进行调整。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/19/origin_3496476_6278902.jpg
为了让玩家更容易接触到我们所设想的核心体验、我们坚持的内容，我们会倾听许多不同意见，并据此推进开发。
当需要进行数值层面的调整时，我们会根据希望玩家游玩的方向来进行平衡调校。但这并不代表一切都只以此为准。前提始终是我们明确知道自己希望玩家体验什么、想实现什么，以及我们所坚持的是什么。

items.title: 时隔 16 年，科幻游戏《遥远的地方》公布发售日期
items.summary: After more than a decade of development, developer Steph Thirion's chill sci-fi game has a release date of loc

content.v: After more than a decade of development, developer Steph Thirion's chill sci-fi game has a release date of locked in. GameSpot can exclusively reveal that Faraway will launch on November 5 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Switch consoles.

Designed to be a tour of the cosmos that you can play with just one button, Faraway was first announced all the way back in 2010, and it follows a shooting star on its journey across the cosmos. Billed as an endless procedurally generated arcade game, the goal is to create constellations on your trek across the stars, using their gravity to slingshot your way to new destinations and keep your cosmic traveler fueled up for the trials that lie ahead of it.

Every run starts from zero, while the universe around you is generated in real time based on your overall performance. As you become more skilled, you'll pick up speed, points, and travel to increasingly difficult regions of the universe. The game also includes 16 handcrafted puzzle stages where you'll have to think out of the galactic box, and it's aiming to be a relaxing mix of discovery, replayability, and long-term mastery.

Faraway is being published by Annapurna Interactive, a company that has made a name for itself by focusing on games with a strong artistic vision . It also published Road Trip earlier this month (a road trip and redemption driving game), and last month saw the release of the critically acclaimed Silent Hill: Townfall . Looking ahead, the label will also publish games like the fantasy adventure Demi and the Fractured Dream, the stylish hidden-object game Uncanyon, and the action-RPG We Kill Monsters.

content.v: 客串之王回归：小岛秀夫将在《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季中再次扮演他在赛博朋克系列中的角色。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792414518_770553_jpg_r.jpg
小岛秀夫将回归饰演大岛秀吉，这位脑舞总监曾在《赛博朋克2077》最早、最令人难忘的任务之一中出现在金碧广场，当时V试图从荒坂眼皮底下偷走一块生物芯片。
《赛博朋克：边缘行者》官推账号发布的公告写道：“你或许还记得在2077年的劫案中，他在金碧广场出现过。现在，这位著名的脑舞导演将再次出现在夜之城。”
小岛秀夫在广播节目KOJI10中表示：“导演和其他人都邀请我出演。一部是大型真人电影，另一部是重要的动画作品。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792415007_547707.jpg
消息公开后，CD Projekt Red联席CEO Michal Nowakowski表示：“与小岛秀夫合作总是令人愉快。”或许我们早该预料到这一点。毕竟，小岛秀夫最近暗示他将在各种媒介中客串亮相。
小岛秀夫在广播节目KOJI10中说：“导演和其他人都邀请我出演。一部是大型真人电影，另一部是重要的动画作品，”
小岛秀夫补充说，或许是心照不宣地暗示了他在《赛博朋克2077》系列中扮演“大岛”一角，“我不喜欢扮演自己。这种情况经常发生。我宁愿扮演侦探之类的角色。”
《赛博朋克：边缘行者》第二季将于10月20日起在Netflix上线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 马斯克要给美国所有儿童送SpaceX股票！总价值700亿
items.summary: 马斯克在X上发帖称，明年他将把自己持有的SpaceX股份赠予美国每个孩子一股

content.v: 10月19日，马斯克在X上发帖称，明年他将把自己持有的SpaceX股份赠予美国每个孩子一股。这一表态将此前小范围的捐赠行动扩大到了全美所有儿童，马斯克同时表示未来还会有更多类似安排。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192049098370.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192049097335.png
按最新股价约146美元、全美约7200万儿童估算，总价值约105亿美元，且他称这只是“众多赠礼中的第一份”。
今年7月，SpaceX总裁格温·肖特韦尔夫妇已向超过200万名美国儿童各捐赠了一股SpaceX股票，马斯克此次的表述，意味着受赠范围将从部分儿童扩展至全美所有儿童。
目前该计划的具体执行方式、资格条件、税务安排及SpaceX股票的估值口径均未公布。SpaceX尚未上市，其股价并非公开交易价格，如何向儿童发放、由谁托管、何时到账等细节仍有待官方进一步说明。

items.title: 《赛博朋克》第三人称mod出炉！官方曾表示"行不通"
items.summary: 沉浸式第三人称MOD迎来2.0.0更新，《赛博朋克2077》除战斗外已能完整以第三人称游玩。

content.v: 《赛博朋克2077》一直是一款第一人称游戏。CD PROJEKT RED此前曾表示，第三人称视角在这个项目上行不通，会丢掉定义这款作品的沉浸感。不过在发售近6年后，一个玩家制作的MOD给出了不同的答案。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192042484916.jpg
这个MOD名为Immersive Third-Person Mod，由作者CybrDrake发布在Nexus Mods上，上个月首次上线。真正让体验改观的，是最近的2.0.0版本更新。
视频赏析：
2.0.0带来了男性V的完整自定义动画集、女性V的新动画、冲刺时的自动翻越、与NPC对话时的头部追踪，以及英文的口型同步等。据介绍，第一人称和第三人称的动画完全独立，玩家可以随时切回第一人称，获得和原版一致的体验，第三人称则使用另一套动画，实现方式类似《上古卷轴5：天际》《辐射4》《星空》等作品。目前除了战斗环节，绝大多数世界交互都能正常运作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192044105998.jpg
由于《赛博朋克2077》一直没有提供第三人称视角，一部分玩家此前始终没能上手。以这个MOD现在的状态，这部分玩家已经可以用第三人称完整体验游戏内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192044184531.jpg

items.title: 《战神》创作者批评PlayStation领导层 称其缺乏灵魂
items.summary: PlayStation近期的许多举措，例如取消实体光盘发行，都引起了广大玩家的强烈不满。不仅玩家们批评了该品牌，就连像David Jaffe这样的业内人士也出于各种原因对PlayStation持负面评价。他在最新视频中指

content.v: PlayStation近期的许多举措，例如取消实体光盘发行，都引起了广大玩家的强烈不满。不仅玩家们批评了该品牌，就连像David Jaffe这样的业内人士也出于各种原因对PlayStation持负面评价。他在最新视频中指出，PlayStation并没有充分利用其现有的IP。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792413918_217240_jpg_r.jpg
在讨论《战神：斯巴达之子》时，David Jaffe分享了他的看法，他认为像《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》这样的游戏比《战神》衍生作品更能代表类银河战士恶魔城游戏。
这位《战神》系列的创作者认为，《战神：斯巴达之子》不应该以现在的状态发售。他还谈到了《战神：劳菲》典藏版，指出尽管售价高达170美元，但附赠的雕像看起来却非常廉价且令人失望。
他说像这样的周边产品在过去是绝对不会获得批准的，这凸显了PlayStation的标准这些年来是如何下降的，这或许是由于领导层缺乏控制和承诺造成的。
“这是完全缺乏创意监管，没有说“不，这还不够好”。我很伤心，因为我怀念那家曾经代表着‘卓越’的公司的灵魂。”
此外，他还表示，在PlayStation工作期间，他经常与管理层、人力资源部门等抗争，以确保粉丝能够玩到最好的游戏版本。这位前《战神》系列开发者表示，由于PlayStation最近的一些糟糕决策，他“对PlayStation很不满”。
当然，这并非大卫·贾菲第一次批评PlayStation。此前，他也曾对《战神》和《漫威金刚狼》提出过类似的严厉批评。

items.title: PS独占大作重磅更新！强调是今年最高分动作游戏之一
items.summary: Housemarque于10月19日为PS5科幻Roguelike射击游戏《沙罗周期》推送 “Zenith”更新

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192016507351.png
Housemarque于10月19日为PS5科幻Roguelike射击游戏《沙罗周期》推送 “Zenith”更新，所有已拥有游戏的玩家可免费获得。设计主管Abebe Tinari表示，本次更新有两个核心目标：为已深入Carcosa的玩家增加重玩价值，同时让更多人能体验这款2026年评分最高的动作游戏之一。
新加入的 “慢速游戏速度” 允许玩家降低游戏整体速度，从而有更多时间观察敌人的攻击预警、判断弹幕轨迹并决定应对方式——跳跃、冲刺、护盾还是弹反。攻击本身不变，只是留给玩家的反应窗口更长。玩家可自行调节减速幅度，并选择在战斗中自动触发或手动开启。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192016571986.png
“自动射击” 则让武器在瞄准敌人时自动开火，减少一个需要持续按住的按键。但装填仍需手动完成，完美装填依然依赖准确的按键时机。配合新增的体感瞄准和已有的按键重映射，玩家现在有更多方式自定义操控。
Carcosan Modifier系统得到大幅扩展。Zenith新增10种保护性修改器，例如“腐化近战强化”——被特定弹幕击中会积累腐化并侵蚀最大生命值，但近战命中时可消耗积累的腐化转化为一次高额伤害。同时新增10种试炼修改器提升难度，例如“敌对再生”——大型敌人被武器击晕后会快速恢复，只有近战才能终结。
这些修改器与新的新游戏+模式“Eclipse Layers” 直接挂钩。通关后，Passage的Armor Matrix会出现新节点，解锁下一层Eclipse Layer。进入新层前，玩家必须选择足够数量的试炼修改器才能开始，25种试炼可自由搭配，部分组合还会产生协同效应。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610192017051228.png
在Eclipse Layers中，Arjun会戴上一顶王冠，护甲泛出金光。试炼越多、修改器平衡值越高，王冠就越华丽。王冠不仅是展示，也是解锁新收集品 “Vision” 的钥匙——12幅刻在石头上的壁画和文字散布在Carcosa，需要达到对应王冠等级才能读取其中的额外故事。

全新模式 “Overlord Rush” 通过Passage的主单元进入，玩家需快速击败本篇中的强大Overlord，并与全球玩家在集成排行榜上竞争。模式分为多个“Set”：“Incursion”和“Ascension”各含三名Overlord，约10分钟可完成；“Totality”则将全部八名Overlord串联成一场连续挑战。排行榜可按主武器筛选，即便无法登顶总榜，也能在自己擅长的武器类别中争取排名。

items.title: 英雄联盟虚拟韩国流行音乐组合 K/DA 沉寂 6 年后重新崛起，推出 Arcane 制作者的新单曲和音乐视频
items.summary: After six years of silence, Riot Games' League of Legends-themed virtual K-pop girl group, K/DA, has returned

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/19/kda-main-1792411869416.jpg
After six years of silence, Riot Games' League of Legends-themed virtual K-pop girl group, K/DA, has returned with Firestarter, a comeback single created by the animation studio behind Arcane.
The single leads K/DA's new EP, set to come out on October 21, which would mark the group's second major release since All Out in 2020.

Returning to the lineup are MIYEON and SOYEON of i-dle, alongside Sophie Powers and Mimi Webb who bring new voices to K/DA’s latest era. The group has previously featured artists including Madison Beer and Jaira Burns, while Seraphine, who joined the virtual girl group for More in 2020 and was voiced by Lexie Liu, is notably absent from the new release. Behind the track are producers Kill Dave and Sebastien Najand, the composer and producer often regarded as one of the architects of K/DA’s sound, having worked on the group’s music since its inception.
Watch it burn. “FIRESTARTER” Music Video is out now // https://t.co/EpvKkgbVYF #KDA #FIRESTARTER #CALLINGALLBLADES https://t.co/3W1SRkTR8X

Behind Firestarter's music video is Fortiche, the French animation studio whose long-standing partnership with Riot dates back to the original Pop/Stars video in 2018. Since then, the two companies have built a creative partnership that extends well beyond music videos, most notably with Arcane, the acclaimed animated series set in the League of Legends universe. With Fortiche involved, the quality of the animation was never really in doubt — and the studio delivers once again.

Originally scheduled for release on Tuesday, October 20, Firestarter arrived as a surprise drop one day earlier, reportedly following leaks teasing the group’s return. The result is a spark that has already turned into a wildfire, with the music video surpassing 4.3 million views on YouTube alone in just nine hours.

It’s been a particularly busy year for Riot Games’ musical universe with three new songs released in less than a month. Heartsteel returned with Live My Life, True Damage made a comeback with Know My Name, marking a milestone for Riot’s virtual bands as the first to deliver a League of Legends Worlds anthem.

Add a collaboration with Pentakill on the orchestral Worlds theme, and K/DA were the last of Riot’s major virtual groups yet to re-enter the spotlight. Teasers released last week made it clear that the wait was almost over, and now the final piece of the musical puzzle is back in place.
A match made in animation Heaven

Fortiche’s signature hybrid approach, blending 3D CGI with hand-painted textures and hand-drawn 2D elements, gives Firestarter a visual identity that feels both real and ideal. The meticulous, almost obsessive details and hidden references are exactly what fans have come to expect from the studio. League players will easily recognize in-game abilities woven into the choreography — like Ahri’s charm or ult — yet these nods never feel forced or overwhelming to viewers unfamiliar with the game.

A music video this saturated with color could easily become visually exhausting, but Fortiche knows when to pull back. Brief, single-frame visual disruptions break up the dominant pink and orange palette, while infrared-inspired sections make the characters appear to radiate heat. Reflections shimmer in the oil-slick ground beneath the characters, and particles of light seem to bring the heat straight through the screen. Every frame feels planned, building toward a visual spectacle that reflects years of creative collaboration.
Catchy beats, fashion, and ballroom choreography

Musically, Firestarter knows exactly how to get under your skin. Built around a catchy rhythm and punchy rap sections, the track constantly plays with contrasts, breaking up its harder-hitting moments with melodic, almost ethereal, pre-choruses that make the chorus hit all the harder when it finally explodes. It is a satisfying build-up that keeps the song moving, balancing fiery attitude with melody and making the hook all the more contagious.

Beyond the animation, great visual composition extends to costumes and choreography. Every look reinforces the members’ personalities, each outfit worthy of high-fashion magazine covers — and it would hardly be surprising to see K/DA gracing those pages again . The choreography, meanwhile, seems inspired by drag ballroom culture, combining sharp poses, commanding gestures and theatrical flair into something utterly mesmerizing. It is bold, precise and unapologetically larger than life, the kind of performance that demands your attention even when everything else is already filling your senses.

With Firestarter, K/DA reminds us why they became one of the most recognisable virtual acts in pop culture. Riot Games and Fortiche have reunited to deliver a music video packed with visual ambition, while the track itself strikes a balance between fan service and mainstream appeal.

items.title: PS5 独占《恶魔之魂重制版》现在不仅可以在 PC 上运行，而且在具有帧生成功能的 RTX 5070 上以两倍的 fps 上限运行
items.summary: It could be smoother but double the frames is nothing to sniff at.

content.v: As a console gaming interloper, I've been watching the PlayStation 5 emulation scene from afar with some interest. The latest development to catch my eye is that emulation of the Demon's Souls Remake, which has been exclusive to Sony's console since its 2020 launch, can now run at up to 120 fps on PC.

Leveraging the very much unofficial KytyPS5 translation layer, YouTuber Geralt Benchmarks shared footage of the remake running on their RTX 5070 and AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D rig. The game reaches for more than 100 fps at 1440p resolution thanks to 2x DLSS frame generation, and you can watch it achieve a mostly buttery 120 fps at 1080p at the eight minute mark here .

Otherwise on Sony's hardware, the game is locked to 60 fps and 1440p resolution while in performance mode. Doubling the frames via emulation is impressive to say the least, especially for what is still a current-gen console.

For the sake of comparison, Geralt Benchmarks also shows the game running on their RTX 5070 rig with those PS5 settings left in place, turning in a performance that occasionally crests over the 70 fps mark. This emulated version isn't without its quirks, though.

Even in Geralt Benchmarks' footage, there's noticeable hitching for one thing, though I personally wouldn't say it's to a deal breaking degree. Though the PS5 only offers a maximum of 60 frames per second, it is incredibly consistent ( Digital Foundry's Tech Review is still worth the watch).

Sony's hardware remains the only official way to play Bluepoint Games' remake—though now the PS5 costs significantly more than it did at launch , I can't say I'm surprised the emulation scene has kicked into overdrive.

The PS3 emulation scene has also been in the news recently, with the popular RPCS3 having had to clamp down on AI submissions (and don't get me started on AI's contentious role within the game decompilation scene either). As for PS4 exclusives finding their way off of Sony's hardware, what's impressed me most recently is technically not emulation, but instead a native PC port of P.T. Say it with me now: Umbasa!

content.v: 之前有消息称，英特尔明年将面向桌面平台带来Nova Lake-S，属于酷睿Ultra 4000系列。显然英特尔稍微改变了现有的命名规则，所使用的数字不再是之前其他酷睿Ultra那样用三位数，而是改回了过去酷睿i时代的四位数。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261019/1792410730_951542_jpg_r.jpg
据TECHPOWERUP报道，英特尔新的“酷睿Ultra 4000系列”命名方式不会局限于桌面平台，移动平台的Nova Lake-HX也将采用相同的四位数格式。不过同样是移动平台，普通的Nova Lake-H等仍然可能会沿用之前的三位数格式，也有消息称四位数格式将覆盖全系列。
Nova Lake-S和Nova Lake-HX本质上是相同的芯片，前者支持LGA 1954插座，后者则采用LGA封装。
另外一个需要澄清的是之前流传的酷睿Ultra 4000系列信息，首批七款产品，其中三款bLLC版。早期信息显示只有配备bLLC（大末级缓存）的版本才会带上LP E-Core，普通版并没有。新的说法是，尽管泄露的表格没有提及，但是普通版也会保留LP E-Core。
Ultra 9 4970K BFC - 8P + 16E + 4LP-E，28核心，32EU集显，TDP为125W，bLLC版;
Ultra 9 4970K - 8P + 16E + 4LP-E，28核心，32EU集显，TDP为125W，标准版;
Ultra 9 4900 BFC - 6P + 12E + 4LP-E，22核心，32EU集显，TDP为65W，bLLC版;
Ultra 7 4870K BFC - 8P + 12E + 4LP-E，24核心，32EU集显，TDP为125W，bLLC版;
Ultra 7 4850K - 8P + 12E + 4LP-E，24核心，32EU集显，TDP为125W，标准版;
Ultra 5 4650K - 6P + 12E + 4LP-E，22核心，32EU集显，TDP为125W，标准版;
Ultra 5 4650KF - 6P + 12E + 4LP-E，22核心，无集显，TDP为125W，标准版。
Nova Lake-S采用了基于Tile的设计，P-Core和E-Core将分别升级至Coyote Cove和Arctic Wolf架构，并辅以LP E-Core用于后台任务管理，同时改用Xe3架构核显，配备NPU 6。

items.title: 没有发行商想要《Outlast》，因为他们“宁愿投资 50,000 美元购买 10 款手机游戏”，因此 Red Barrels 依靠公共投资计划和自己的积蓄来代替
items.summary: "Everything was on the line" during Outlast's development.

content.v: Outlast has long since established itself as a horror gaming staple with an impressive track record of two mainline games, a DLC, and an online multiplayer game that still scares the bejesus out of me. So it's hard to believe that there was a time when developer Red Barrels was unsure whether or not it'd even be able to get it out of the door.

After trying and failing to convince Ubisoft to let him make a horror game and just generally feeling like it was time to move on, Philippe Morin, co-founder of Red Barrels decided to leave and form a small 10-person team with developers from other big-budget studios. Their first pitch: a horror game.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/v8ZttZKedGeJNykywStPfZ-1920-80.jpg

“We thought at first that we’d come up with the pitch within three or four months and shop it around to a few publishers," Morin says in an interview with GameSpot . "And we’d find out pretty quickly if it works or not." Unfortunately, it turned out to be the latter, at least at first.

Morin explains how many of the publishers they approached would “rather invest $50,000 in 10 mobile games than $500,000 in [Outlast].” This was likely equal parts because of how obsessed everyone was with mobile games back then and thanks to how niche the horror genre was perceived as. 13 years later the horror genre is still perceived as one of the smaller areas of interest in gaming, despite all of the amazing games released and the revival of two staples, Silent Hill and Resident Evil.
“We were experienced game developers,” Morin says. “But we didn’t know much about that side–publishing and marketing and sales and all that. So we had to learn on the fly.”
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3FajdGNGZwTo5gEnsspkbC-1920-80.jpg

Red Barrel finally had to turn to a publicly funded investment program, the Canada Media Fund (CMF) to finance Outlast, with a whopping $1 million dollar investment. But even that wasn't enough. The developers had to take money out of savings, credit cards, and leverage home mortgages to get the project over the line; a huge financial risk. “Everything was pretty much on the line,” Morin recalls. “Of course, it meant working very long, long hours. We were in a sprint to release the game before running out of money.”

Luckily this story ended well, very well actually. After just five months Red Barrels managed to hit the goal of 400,000 copies sold and while not all of them were at full price after sales it was still enough for the team to get some "pretty significant bonuses."

Outlast would go on to sell 15 million copies as of 2018 and spawn three other games, the final being the recent multiplayer horror game The Outlast Trials which achieved an all-time concurrent player count peak just 11-days ago of 147,955. Pretty solid for a multiplayer survival horror game.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dmLfcTEceHMYUpsciYxiDT-1920-80.jpg

content.v: CD Projekt Red已于10月19日为Switch 2版《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》推送5.01补丁，大部分地区今日即可下载，日版将在通过认证后跟进。此次更新针对Switch 2平台做了多项专属调整，并同步修复了全平台的多项遗留问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191923448421.png
Switch 2专属改进是本次补丁的重点。官方调整了图像锐化与分辨率，以提升画面清晰度和保真度；修复了在游戏内区域间切换时偶发的崩溃问题；优化了跨平台Mod支持的缓存处理；修复了爬梯子时HD震动仅在左侧Joy-Con 2上生效的问题，以及地图图钉可能被放置在周围黑边上的异常。此外，动态分辨率缩放在特定配置下可能导致的画面伪影也已修复。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191923539116.png
全平台层面，补丁对泛光、色调映射、角色光照、光线追踪和路径追踪进行了视觉调整，并在图形设置中新增泛光、光束和景深选项。玩法方面修复了“自动涂抹剑油”仅在当前会话生效、船只可能失控并忽略地形碰撞、闪避响应延迟、炸弹在禁用状态下仍可投掷等问题，还为“爆炸护盾”技能加入了伤害反弹。UI方面修复了技能点弹窗卡住、冥想界面输入提示闪烁等异常。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/19/small_202610191924003787.png
此外，补丁还处理了一项可能影响存档文件数据的问题，并为已受影响的存档加入了补救措施。

items.title: Nvidia 表示 RTX 5090 并未消亡，但它已从该公司的官方市场神秘消失
items.summary: Another Schrödinger's graphics card?

content.v: Rumours have been circulating as of late that Nvidia has halted production of its flagship RTX 5090 graphics card , in favour of moving the GB202 silicon towards RTX Pro data center GPUs instead. However, Jeff Fisher, the senior vice president of Nvidia's GeForce business unit, has denied its demise at an event in Taipei.

"The supply chain (capacity) is indeed somewhat constrained, but Nvidia is doing everything it can to get the product on the market," says Fisher (via 4Gamers ). "Although there are other variants of the RTX 5090 (chip), production has not been discontinued, and Nvidia will continue to ship, which is very important."

However, the card has disappeared from Nvidia's official US marketplace , and has reached near-unobtanium levels elsewhere. We've stopped tracking the card on our best GPU deals page in recent months, as the only listings we can find have ludicrous prices from third-party sellers.

It appears we have another Schrödinger's graphics card situation to contend with. On the one hand, a (very) senior Nvidia official reportedly says the card is still a-go. Taiwanese outlet CNA quotes Fisher as saying "it's not true" in regards to the ceased production rumours, although this is via machine translation.

On the other hand, while GB202 silicon for consumer RTX 5090 cards may still be under production in some form or fashion, the finished GPUs themselves seem to have gone AWOL. If even Nvidia itself isn't listing them, it's difficult to imagine where meaningful stock might exist elsewhere—although two pallets have gone missing from a Brazilian airport , so there are at least some of the beasties out there somewhere.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dbyMS2G9kvcew8wvqTVruE-1920-80.jpg

Redditors have even taken to pointing out the odd single example sitting on a retail shelf , which has become worthy of note in its own right. The fact that some are now highlighting individual cards, like bird watchers with binoculars around their necks speculating on the existence of a rare warbler, really does make it seem like the Nvidia card is no more. Or, at the very least, so supply constrained as to be functionally unobtainable.

Rumours surrounding another Schrödinger's GPU, the lesser-spotted RTX 5080 24 GB/Super , continue to pop up now and then. But with the RTX 60-series still believed to be a while away yet, and the memory supply crisis still biting, the GPU market really is looking rather barren in the last half of 2026, RTX 5090 or otherwise.

items.title: 4块钱的1L冰红茶，怎么没人喝了？
items.summary: 朋友，你有多久没喝过冰红茶了？

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
朋友，你有多久没喝过冰红茶了？
几年前，冰红茶曾一度在网上爆火，以“屌丝饮料”的身份红极一时，成为无数牛马追捧的神饮，常温马尿，冰镇国窖的 说法谁人不知，谁人不晓？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/183.jpg
但事到如今，除了在牢大相关的梗图里，我们已经很难再从网上寻找到其更多的痕迹。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1124.jpg
所以朋友，如果你还在喝冰红茶，我只能遗憾的告诉你，你在饮料圈已经落伍了，现在的年轻人们，更喜欢“喝大水”。
那么，何为喝大水？
大水有表里两层意思。
表层意思顾名思义，就是买大包装的矿泉水或纯净水来喝，以1.5L左右的为主流，也有部分狠人会选择5L的超级大容量。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1262.jpg
编辑部里，我和大家最喜爱的一柳渡江老师都是这种大水的忠实拥趸，出差在外经常购买。甚至大柳老师更加硬核，会经常拿着大水的空瓶在公司或者机场接满水喝，买都不用买。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1344.jpg
注意用词，是“接”不是“买”
而里层意思是指喝水的动作要大口猛灌，背后意指应该多喝水。
如果你经常喝大水，可能就会和刚知道“喝大水”风潮时有一样的疑惑：这个存在已久且稀松常见的东西到底怎么就突然火了？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1449.jpg
这个说法10月5日以“全网进入大水时代”的话题登上抖音热榜，在10月8日“#喝大水”登上微博热搜，有人宣传了“大水”的诸多好处，受到了广大网友的认可。
这一点从网友们对其的总结就可见一斑，提出了所谓“大水四性”的理论。
其一，喝大水足够健康。
当代年轻人，被咖啡、奶茶、雪碧、冰红茶等多种饮料包围，一度对喝水嗤之以鼻。然而随之而来的血糖问题也成为了不少人的困扰。而反观大水，就算一口气喝到撑，除了需要多跑几趟厕所之外似乎也就没什么其他的坏处了，还有着清热去火，预防肾结石等好处。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1691.jpg
其二，喝大水更加便宜。
《中国居民膳食指南（2016）》中指出，成年人每天要喝1500毫升至1700毫升水。而一瓶1.5L装的大水正好满足一天的需求，且仅需要3元左右。喝一杯霸王茶姬的钱，足够喝整整一周的大水！
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1799.jpg
其三，可以锻炼身体。
1.5L水换算下来，大概可以等于一个1.5KG重的哑铃，出门随身带个哑铃到处跑，那自然是很锻炼身体。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1863.jpg
其四，可以增强个人气场。
试想一下，在商场公园机场车站等人多的公共场合，你举着个大瓶子仰头往嘴里一顿猛灌水，那场面、那气势，谁见了不心里说一声“此乃当世之豪杰”？
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/1947.jpg
不过在我看来，这大水四性总结的还是有失偏颇。
且不说后两点看起来就是大伙玩梗瞎说来凑数的，单说便宜这一点，我觉得如果是靠买来的大水，无疑是落了下风的。这一点我们都应当向大柳老师学习，应当想尽一切白嫖喝水之手段。当然，提个大瓶子去公共场合接水一事对于心性的修炼要求过高，我等实力较弱之人大可以从想办法“喝垮公司”开始做起。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/11110.jpg
右边为我日常在公司用的1L水壶
随着这个梗的火热，就不乏有很多医生站出来提出“专家建议”。
其中建议最多的，是提倡不要盲目的喝太多水，有可能会造成“水中毒”。
为此，我特意去查了一下水中毒的喝水标准：肾脏的排水能力大概在每小时800-1000毫升，而如果一段时间摄入的水分超过了这一阈值，就可能引发水中毒……
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261019_cza_511_1/11269.jpg
emmmmm，理论上当然是没问题的，但日常生活中喝水，真有人会动不动每个小时就能往肚子里灌一整瓶1.5l的大水吗？且不说灌不灌的下去，肚子撑也撑得慌，只要正常生活，大概也不会有人这么喝吧，应该……不会吧。
还有心理医生提出，这股热潮的背后，是年轻人在不确定的生活中，追求掌控感的一种表现。即很多年轻人无法决定前途、未来等人生大事，但一天喝多少水完全自主，是可以掌控的。
这话乍一看好像有那么点道理，但仔细想想其实完全没说到点子上。
对于想要追求掌控感这件事，其实说的也没什么错，如今的年轻牛马们确实有太多无法掌控的东西，大到婚姻、事业、社会变化，小到今晚按照预定的计划早睡，可能都很难以自身意志左右结果。但即便如此，说能决定自己每天能喝多少水就是掌控感的体现，是不是也太可怜了？
喝大水热潮背后其实根本没那么复杂，本质上就一点，如今的年轻人正在用更低的成本追求更高品质的生活。
纵观近五年有关饮料的网络出圈梗，从“秋天的第一杯奶茶”到“屌丝饮料”再到如今的“喝大水”，我们其实可以看出一个不断前进的脉络——从看清消费主义陷阱了，再到关注自身健康。
现在这个社会，无数商家为了让你花钱买东西，可谓是无所不用其极咱就说这个“秋天第一杯奶茶”吧，从其后续的宣传稿方式和走向看，说一句挑拨情侣关系那是一点不为过，本来日常说喝个奶茶可能也就买了，非得包装个非买不可的噱头进去。
当然营造个噱头让人买东西的事很常见，二游夏天出个泳装皮肤我也上赶着去买，但你的噱头总得能说服人吧？你说中秋的第一口月饼，端午的第一口粽子谁不吃？秋天和奶茶的关系到底是啥我至今想不通，那秋天第一个大嘴巴你要不要？
最绷不住的是今年又上热搜了
所以很多看清的人选择反抗，“屌丝饮料”4块钱1L装冰红茶应运而火。
而在近几年，预制菜、各种食品添加剂等问题愈演愈烈，年轻人们的亚健康状态也成了一个常热的网络话题，相关的健身、养生博主更是层出不穷。
随着各种各样的科普与宣传，大家伙或多或少都知道了日常怎么吃怎么动能对身体更好，也逐渐学会了去看商品的背面：配料表和营养成分表，来分辨一种食物健康与否。
于是，奶茶自不必说，含有大量果葡糖浆的冰红茶也逐渐走出了想追求健康生活的人群视野，就算想喝点饮料，也会尽量选择“无糖”。而填上这一空缺的，就是从哪个方面看都足够健康的“大水”。
当然谁都清楚，只是多喝点水，并不会从根本上改变一个人的健康状况，但这届年轻人不就是如此吗，人懒又怕死。
就像知道高糖饮料不好选择喝水，类似的例子还有很多：知道运动对身体好，但是下班后太累又懒得动；知道熬夜伤身体，但玩到兴头上又哪里管得了那么多；知道吃外卖高油高盐不好，那就偶尔吃几天健康餐对冲一下……
就不说别处了，编辑部的日常就是如此，一个二个都以自己能在1点睡觉为荣，问起吃喝个个都在控糖控油。
原创组养生小讲堂
但别误会，我说这些并无意说教，毕竟我也如此。时代与社会的现状在那摆着，我们想要把闲暇时间用来娱乐那再正常不过了。
屌丝饮料也好，喝大水也罢，包括如今自嘲文化的流行，都是我们愈发清醒的同时，还在努力掌控自己生活的一大证明，从这一角度来说，我认为将其称之为追求对生活的掌控感，还是很恰当的。
所以再别说了，赶紧去楼下便利店小卖部买个大水吧，备不住当资本注意到这件事之后，三块多的大水就要涨价了呢！
